content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 21 is structurally strong — mutual cap, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and a full "Excluded Claims" set (confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), plus confirmation that Customer's payment obligation is not capped damages. The single material failure is the cap *quantum*: it is keyed to "Fees", defined at §1.5/1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, and only under the first Order Form — an illusory cap that fails the fallback's "12 months of fees" basis. One surgical replacement in § 21.1 resets the basis to all amounts paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, reaching the preferred position without touching the rest of the section.
